verdict.rationale: No dedicated data-export feature is documented. Exit is indirectly eased by the open-source, run-anywhere model: local, Docker or VM backends, model-agnostic use and bring-your-own LLM keys. The docs also mention serializable agent settings and browser session recordings replayable with the open rrweb format. Missing for 10: a documented export of conversations and history (especially from OpenHands Cloud), open-format export of all user data, migration/offboarding docs, and independent corroboration.
